verdict.rationale: Docs show a clear SDK/CLI path (`@vercel/sandbox`, `sandbox create`/`sandbox run`) to spin up isolated Linux microVMs, with fast startup via managed images or snapshots that skip dependency installation, matching the 'one call, live environment in seconds' story. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on timing benchmarks confirming 'seconds' latency and third-party corroboration beyond first-party docs.
